 TBI: Morley’s stolen truck located in Illinois, inmate still at large 
 By Catherine Boulton , LeeAnne Morefield and Nyana Whitelaw Published : Oct. 26, 2026 at 8:42 AM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google UPDATE (10/27/26): The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation has confirmed that the stolen truck, used by escaped inmate Jacob Morley, has been located in Marion, Illinois. 
 Officials say Morley’s whereabouts are still unknown at this time. If anyone has any information that could assist officials, contact 1-800-TBI-FIND. 
 If you see Morley, do not approach him. Call 911 immediately.
 Stolen truck, used by escaped inmate Jacob Morley, found in Illinois. (Gray News) UPDATE (5:30 p.m.): New video shows escaped inmate Jacob Morley stealing a white 2008 Ford F-350 (TN tag 138BBQV) around 1 a.m. Monday from the 400 block of Keystone Dr. in Lake County. 
 The Hornbeak Fire Department also captured security camera footage that shows the escapee in the stolen vehicle. Morley was seen driving through Troy at approximately 1:18 a.m. Monday.
 UPDATE (4:40 p.m.): The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation along with local, state, and federal partners, continue to look for escaped inmate Jacob Allen Morley.
 Newly obtained video shows Morley stealing a white 2008 Ford F-350, Tennessee tag 138BBQV, around 1 a.m. Monday.
 The truck was stolen from the 400 block of Keystone Drive. It has an air compressor in the bed and is marked with Lindamood Planting Company on the side.
 Jacob Morley escaped from Northwest Correctional Complex on Oct. 25. (Gray News) Residents are urged to check home security systems, including doorbell cameras and trail cameras, for any sightings of Morley or the stolen truck.
 If you see Morley or the vehicle, do not approach. Call 911 immediately or contact TBI at 1-800-TBI-FIND. See less
 UPDATE (1:50 p.m.) : The Tennessee Department of Correction is asking for the public’s assistance in locating convicted murderer Jacob Morley. 
 Morley has been added to the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation’s Most Wanted list, and a reward of up to $2,500 is available for information leading to his arrest. Residents in the area are asked to check home security and doorbell cameras, trail and hunting cameras, and other surveillance systems for possible sightings or activity. Anyone who sees Morley or has information about his whereabouts should not approach him. Call 911 immediately or contact TBI at 1-800-TBI-FIND.
 Tennessee Department of Correction PREVIOUS COVERAGE 
 JACKSON, Tenn. (WBBJ) - A Tennessee Department of Correction inmate, Jacob Morley, escaped from custody at the Northwest Correctional Complex on Oct. 25, 2026, at approximately 11:30 p.m. 
 Morley is serving a life sentence for a conviction in Carter County for first-degree murder, as well as aggravated burglary, tampering with evidence, evading arrest and vandalism.
 Jacob Morley escaped Northwest Correctional Complex on Oct. 25. (Gray News) Morley is a 28-year-old white man who is 5-foot-11 and weighs approximately 240 pounds. He has brown hair and green eyes. Anyone with information regarding Morley’s whereabouts is asked to contact the Tennessee Department of Correction at 1-844-832-3463 or 911. Do not attempt to apprehend this fugitive.
 The Tennessee Department of Correction is actively responding to an escape from the Northwest Correctional Complex involving Jacob Morley (Tomis ID: 674793). Public safety is our top priority, and we are working closely with law enforcement agencies to apprehend the individual as quickly as possible. We urge anyone with information to contact 911 immediately.
 Bradley Canada, TN Department of Correction Public Information Officer The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation has added Morley to the state’s Most Wanted list. He should be considered dangerous. There is a $2,500 reward for any information leading to his arrest.
